verdict.rationale: Turso documents tearing down per-user or per-agent databases via the API (turso-docs-8), letting Pro and Enterprise customers keep data in their own S3 buckets (turso-docs-27), and customer-held per-database encryption keys with data residency control (turso-docs-28). Data can also be exported via dump (turso-docs-47), so users can delete whole databases and control where data lives. missing for 10: configurable retention policies or windows (e.g., PITR/backup retention duration), documented guarantees that deleted databases and their backups are purged, and independent or hands-on corroboration of deletion behavior.
